name: Snipd
tagline: AI podcast player with chapters, episode summaries, and shareable highlights.
description: Snipd is an AI-powered podcast app that transcribes episodes, breaks them into chapters, and generates summaries and key takeaways you can read before listening. While playing, it detects highlight-worthy moments and lets you save them as 'snips' — short clips with auto-generated transcripts and notes — and you can chat with an episode's content. Built by a Zurich-based team, it positions podcast listening as active learning.

modelSupport.notes: AI transcription, chapterization, and summarization built into the player.

edge: A full podcast player that turns listening into spaced-repetition study notes — not just a summarizer bolted onto a feed.
cons: Premium needed for unlimited AI features
AI processing can lag for niche episodes
